experiment_data.method_description: Human Embryonic Kidney (HEK) 293 cells and SH-SY5Y cells were grown in DMEM containing 10% FBS in a 5% CO2 atmosphere. Cells were transfected with either pcDNA3-parkin (wild-type or various mutants) or empty vector using Lipofectamine 2000. For sequential detergent extraction, cells were scraped and lysed in Triton X-100 buffer, centrifuged, and the supernatant (S) was collected. The pellet was then sequentially extracted with SDS and RIPA buffer. Protein concentrations were determined using the Bio-Rad Protein Assay. Equivalent amounts of protein were separated by SDS-PAGE and transferred to PVDF membranes. Membranes were probed with anti-parkin antibody (HRP-conjugated) and detected by chemiluminescence. Proteasome inhibition was assessed by treating cells with 10 µM lactacystin for 16 hours prior to lysis. To analyze protein solubility in PBS, Triton X-100-resistant pellets were washed and sonicated in PBS.
experiment_data.cell_line: Human Embryonic Kidney (HEK) 293 cells and SH-SY5Y cells

experiment_data.method_description: 5 × 10^4 HEK 293 or SH-SY5Y cells were seeded onto polylysine coated sterile glass coverslips in a 24-well culture plate a day prior to transfection. Cells were transfected with either pcDNA3-parkin (wild-type or various mutants) or empty vector using Lipofectamine 2000. 48 hours post-transfection, cells were fixed with 4% paraformaldehyde, permeabilized with 0.1% Triton X-100, and blocked with 10% normal goat serum. Cells were then incubated with primary antibodies (anti-parkin, anti-ubiquitin, or anti-γ-tubulin) followed by fluorescently labeled secondary antibodies. Coverslips were mounted with SlowFade mounting medium and visualized using a Leica TCS NT confocal laser scanning microscope. For Nocodazole treatment, cells were treated with 10 µM Nocodazole for 12 hours prior to fixation. Co-localization studies with CDCrel-1, Synphilin-1, and α-synuclein were performed by co-transfecting the respective constructs with parkin constructs and observing their cellular distribution.
experiment_data.cell_line: Human Embryonic Kidney (HEK) 293 cells and SH-SY5Y cells

Cells were transfected with either pcDNA3-parkin (wild-type or various mutants) or empty vector using Lipofectamine 2000. 48 hours post-transfection, cells were fixed with 4% paraformaldehyde, permeabilized with 0.1% Triton X-100, and blocked with 10% normal goat serum. Cells were then incubated with primary antibodies (anti-parkin, anti-ubiquitin, or anti-γ-tubulin) followed by fluorescently labeled secondary antibodies. Coverslips were mounted with SlowFade mounting medium and visualized using a Leica TCS NT confocal laser scanning microscope. For Nocodazole treatment, cells were treated with 10 µM Nocodazole for 12 hours prior to fixation. Co-localization studies with CDCrel-1, Synphilin-1, and α-synuclein were performed by co-transfecting the respective constructs with parkin constructs and observing their cellular distribution.
experiment_data.cell_line: Human Embryonic Kidney (HEK) 293 cells and SH-SY5Y cells
